name: Cylindrical Jar
material: lead glazed earthenware with molded relief
dimensions: Diameter: 27.3 cm (10 3/4 in.); height: 26.7 cm (10 1/2 in.)
summary: Vessels like this often are call "hill jars" since many survive with conical covers shaped in rising peaks. "Squatting bear" feet and false animal-mask ring handles are common to the group.
